messages:
maria.chen: Heads-up — compliance asked for a KMS audit bundle: envelope-encryption evidence, recent key rotations, and RBAC change history for the last 90 days. Can infra assemble?

sam.patel: I can pull CloudTrail + CloudWatch for AWS. Which keys to target? primary CMEK alias and any imported keys?

maria.chen: Start with alias/redwood-prod-cmek and any CMKs tagged env:prod or purpose:data-encryption. Also include GCP CMEK at projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/data/cryptoKeys/prod-key and Azure Key Vault kv-prod-redwood.

jules: Quick checklist to collect: 1) CloudTrail events: GenerateDataKey, Decrypt, ReEncrypt, CreateKey, ScheduleKeyDeletion, UpdateKeyPolicy 2) GCP Audit Logs: protoPayload.methodName like 'cloudkms.*' (Decrypt, AsymmetricSign, GenerateRandomBytes) 3) Azure Diagnostics: OperationName containing 'unwrapKey' or 'wrapKey' + DiagnosticSettings export 4) snapshots of key policies / IAM bindings + diffs 5) rotation job logs and verification of new key material usage

sam.patel: CloudTrail/Athena query I'll run (90d window):
```sql
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, sourceIPAddress
FROM cloudtrail_logs
WHERE eventSource='kms.amazonaws.com'
  AND eventName IN ('Decrypt','GenerateDataKey','ReEncrypt','CreateKey','ScheduleKeyDeletion','PutKeyPolicy')
  AND eventTime >= date_sub('day',90,current_date);
```
And CloudWatch Logs Insights example: `filter @message like /Decrypt/ | stats count() by userIdentity`

maria.chen: Please paste runnable queries + the S3 export location and checksum. Compliance needs chain-of-custody: who changed CMK policy and when (diffs). Redact plaintext data keys / ciphertext blobs in artifacts.

aisha: For GCP I'll export matching audit logs to BigQuery. Sample BQ query:
```sql
SELECT timestamp, protopayload_auditlog.methodName, authenticationInfo.principalEmail, resourceName
FROM `redwood_prod.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE protopayload_auditlog.methodName LIKE '%Decrypt%'
  AND timestamp >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 90 DAY);
```
I'll also grant read-only access to the compliance GCP group for the export table.

infra-bot: rotation-schedule: alias/redwood-prod-cmek => 90d. Last rotation event recorded 2025-12-04T03:12:22Z (task=r-rot-1223).

jules: Also capture RBAC changes: AWS PutRolePolicy/AttachRolePolicy, IAM console changes, and for GCP look for SetIamPolicy on cryptoKey resources. Those are needed to show who could call `cloudkms.cryptoKeys.version` or `cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.use` etc.

sam.patel: Azure diagnostics check — confirm DiagnosticSettings exist and are forwarded. Kusto example I will run against Log Analytics:
```kql
AzureDiagnostics
| where ResourceProvider == 'MICROSOFT.KEYVAULT' and OperationName contains 'UnwrapKey' or OperationName contains 'WrapKey'
| where TimeGenerated >= ago(90d)
| project TimeGenerated, CallerIpAddress_s, Caller_s, CorrelationId_g
```
If diag not enabled, note that in the bundle and include ARM template to enable.

compliance-bot: SOC2 evidence checklist summary: 1) exported log bundle (AWS S3 / GCS / Azure Storage) 2) key policy snapshots + diffs (timestamped) 3) rotation proof (rotation job logs, KMS API responses) 4) RBAC binding snapshots 5) retention proof (where logs are stored and retention config) 6) signed manifest describing redactions

maria.chen: Goal: initial bundle by EOD Friday. Owners: @sam.patel (AWS bundle + S3 export + checksum), @aisha (GCP BigQuery export + table/view), @jules (Azure KV diagnostics + RBAC diffs + small playbook for suspected key compromise). I'll compile into a single tar.gz and upload to the compliance bucket.

sam.patel: Working on it now. Plan: run Athena export -> write results to s3://redwood-compliance/kms-evidence/1749988888/ and create a SHA256 checksum file. Expect first export in ~3 hours. Will redact requestParameters.ciphertextBlob fields before final upload.

aisha: Starting export job; table name will be `redwood_prod.kms_audit_export_1749988888`. Granting read to compliance-redwood@project. Will share BQ location and query results once done.

jules: I'll draft a 1-page incident playbook for key compromise: 1) rotate CMK and force rewrap of envelope keys 2) revoke service account / IAM grants 3) run data re-encryption job with new GenerateDataKey output 4) notify downstream teams + rotate credentials 5) escalate to secops and legal. I'll attach to bundle.

maria.chen: Important: include a short note in the artifact about envelope encryption design: data keys are generated via GenerateDataKey and never logged in plaintext. We should explicitly document redaction approach so auditors know we didn't remove required fields inadvertently.

sam.patel: Acknowledged — will include a signed manifest listing what was redacted and why. Uploading partial results to the S3 prefix now.

aisha: Export finished, sharing table and a link in a follow-up message.

jules: Uploading KV diagnostic export and RBAC diffs to the same S3 prefix.

maria.chen: Thanks all. I'll stitch the bundle, add the signed manifest, and send to compliance. If anything blocks the EOD target ping this thread. :thumbsup:
